name: restaurant-os
description: Restaurant OS — table QR ordering, live kitchen dashboard, UPI billing. Next.js + Express + Supabase.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
